description:
You are an experimental psychologist at an anxiety research lab. Your lab uses a differential fear conditioning paradigm with an adaptive US (unconditioned stimulus) intensity staircase — a method validated by Lonsdorf et al. (2017, Psychophysiology). Using PsychoPy Coder (not Builder), write a complete Python script for a fear conditioning experiment.

The script must implement: (1) a habituation phase (10 trials: CS+ and CS- presented as colored squares, counterbalanced via participant number modulo 2); (2) an acquisition phase (CS+ paired with a white noise US, CS- unpaired); (3) a PsychoPy data.StairHandler with startVal=0.8, stepSizes=[0.1, 0.05], nReversals=4, stepType='lin' to adaptively adjust US amplitude based on participant ratings; (4) data saving via ExperimentHandler to /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/data/; (5) a visual rating scale for US aversiveness after each US delivery; (6) correct CS/US timing (CS duration 4s, US onset 3.5s into CS).

The script must import from psychopy (core, visual, data, event) and be saved as a single .py file to:
  /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/fear_conditioning.py
